sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which technology is primarily utilized in precision farming to monitor crop health and field conditions remotely using spatial data?
In the construction industry, what is the primary purpose of creating a structural blueprint before laying the foundation?
options: A) To calculate precise dimensions and material requirements
B) To paint the exterior walls
questions.answer: A) To calculate precise dimensions and material requirements

questions.question_text: State whether True or False: In rooftop gardening, using dense, heavy soil is always preferred over lightweight potting mixes to anchor the plants.
Which agricultural practice involves growing different crops sequentially on the same plot of land to improve soil health and prevent pest cycles?
When shaping raw metal materials in a workshop, which safety equipment is most critical to protect the operator's eyes from flying metal shavings?
What is the primary function of a 'Greenhouse' in modern horticultural practices?
options: A) To store harvested crops in cold temperatures
B) To control micro-climatic conditions for optimal plant growth
questions.answer: B) To control micro-climatic conditions for optimal plant growth

questions.question_text: State whether True or False: Precision farming techniques typically result in a higher wastage of fertilizers and water compared to traditional broadcasting methods.
In basic construction masonry, what is the binding material commonly mixed with sand and water to hold bricks together?
Which of the following is NOT a fundamental raw material shaping process used in manufacturing?
What type of farming utilizes water solvent nutrient solutions instead of traditional soil to grow plants?
Define 'Precision Farming' and state its primary objective. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Precision farming is an agricultural management strategy utilizing digital technology, like GPS and sensors, to observe and respond to crop variations, optimizing returns while preserving agricultural resources.

questions.question_text: List two essential safety precautions a worker must take before operating a lathe machine to shape materials. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Before operating a lathe, a worker must ensure all machine guards are securely in place and remove any loose clothing or jewelry that could get entangled in the rotating parts.

questions.question_text: Why is the selection of lightweight growth mediums critical for setting up a rooftop garden? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Lightweight mediums, like cocopeat and perlite, are crucial to prevent exceeding the building roof's structural load-bearing capacity, ensuring the building remains safe while supporting the garden.

questions.question_text: Briefly describe the purpose of 'curing' in the concrete construction process. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Curing involves maintaining adequate moisture and temperature conditions for freshly poured concrete, allowing the cement to hydrate fully and achieve its designed structural strength and durability.

questions.question_text: What is the function of a soil moisture sensor in smart irrigation systems? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A soil moisture sensor measures the volumetric water content in the soil. It triggers automated irrigation systems to release water only when levels drop below a specific threshold, preventing water wastage.

questions.question_text: Explain the step-by-step layout process of establishing a basic drip irrigation network for a rooftop vegetable garden. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: First, connect a main water supply line to a pressure regulator and filter. Next, lay out lateral polyethylene tubing across the planters. Finally, install individual emitter valves directly over the root zone of each plant to deliver measured water drops.

questions.question_text: Describe the core difference between 'forging' and 'casting' as methods for shaping raw materials in the manufacturing sector. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Casting involves pouring molten liquid metal into a pre-designed mold to solidify into a shape. Forging, however, shapes solid metal by applying localized compressive forces, typically using a heavy hammer or press, resulting in structurally stronger components.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: A local farmer wants to upgrade from traditional manual farming to a technology-driven precision agronomy layout to improve his wheat yield. Outline a comprehensive strategy detailing the implementation of soil mapping, variable rate technology (VRT), and yield monitoring systems to optimize his farm. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The farmer must first conduct GPS-enabled soil mapping to identify specific nutrient deficiency zones across his field. Using Variable Rate Technology (VRT), tractors can then automatically adjust fertilizer application rates in real-time based on the soil map data. Finally, equipping harvesters with yield monitors will generate spatial crop production data to refine future planting strategies continuously.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: A vocational construction team is tasked with building a small, sustainable brick structure. Detail the sequential construction workflow they must follow, starting from site clearance and foundation trenching up to the final structural curing phase, emphasizing quality control at each step. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The team must first clear the site and excavate trenches precisely according to the blueprint. A reinforced concrete foundation is then poured and leveled. Once set, masons lay bricks using the English bond method, continuously checking vertical alignment with a plumb bob. Finally, the brickwork is plastered and cured with water for several days to maximize structural integrity.
